visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation style: A cartoon character with brown hair, black headphones, and a red-and-white striped shirt sits at a desk with a professional microphone. A white cat with black spots sits in the foreground. The background is a simple purple room. Yellow subtitles appear at the top. (2) A graphic scene showing a line of people; a white silhouette leads a group of three blue figures with exaggerated wide smiles. (3) The scene cuts back to the character at the desk, gesturing while talking. (4) Graphic showing two blue plastic bags filled with trash hanging on a seat back with a net pocket. (5) Extreme close-up of the cartoon character's face with narrowed eyes and a skeptical expression. (6) A hand or foot graphic showing a big toe poking through the mesh of a black net pocket. (7) Return to the desk scene. (8) Text graphic on a white background: 'Cheap -> Not durable' and 'Expensive -> Reluctant to throw away' with hand-drawn blue and yellow highlight marks. (9) A poster graphic appears with two large cartoon hands holding an eyeball-like logo and the title 'IS IT THAT BAD?'. (10) Montage of the character talking interspersed with text details for an event including dates, times, and location logos for RE-THINK and FamilyMart.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Moral Examples -> Economic Philosophy -> Event Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video utilizes a popular animation persona and humor to criticize common discourteous public behaviors (like queue-cutting or leaving trash) and poor consumer habits. It effectively bridges these relatable life frustrations to promote the 'IS IT THAT BAD?' exhibition by RE-THINK and FamilyMart at Huashan 1914, encouraging social rethink and environmental awareness.
